zh: 你见过九十多岁还开跑车的老头吗？他叫黄永玉。
en: Ever met a man in his nineties who still drove a sports car? His name is Huang Yongyu.

zh: 可在他心里，他一辈子，都是十二岁那年背着小包袱出门的孩子。
en: But in his heart, he was always the twelve-year-old who left home with a little bundle on his back.

zh: 他的故事，从湘西凤凰开始。
en: His story begins in Fenghuang, in western Hunan.

zh: 沱江的水，吊脚楼，青石板路，他记了一辈子。六十多年后，才全写进一本书里。
en: The Tuo River, the stilt houses, the stone lanes — he carried them all his life, and sixty years later, he put them into a book.

zh: 十二岁，他背着小包袱，顺着小河，穿过洞庭湖，去“翻阅另一本大书”。
en: At twelve, he shouldered a small bundle, followed the river across Dongting Lake, and set out to read “another great book”.

zh: 辗转谋生，没有靠山，只有一支画笔，一把刻刀。
en: He drifted from place to place with no one to lean on — just a brush and a carving knife.

zh: 路上，有位亲人一直牵挂着他，就是表叔沈从文。
en: Along the way, a relative kept him in mind: his uncle, the writer Shen Congwen.

zh: 从一九四六年起，两人书信往来，攒下一两百封信。
en: From 1946, they wrote to each other — a hundred or two hundred letters in all.

zh: 二十九岁，他成了中央美术学院的老师。
en: At twenty-nine, he became a teacher at the Central Academy of Fine Arts.

zh: 可站在讲台上，他心里那个少年，一点儿也没长大。
en: But standing at the lectern, the boy inside him had not grown up at all.

zh: 七十年代，他画了一只一只眼睁、一只眼闭的猫头鹰。
en: In the 1970s, he painted an owl with one eye open and one eye shut.

zh: 它曾引来不少风波，后来，却成了他最有名的形象之一。
en: It stirred up quite a storm — yet it later became one of his best-known images.

zh: 一九八〇年，庚申猴年，他设计的生肖邮票发行。
en: In 1980, the Year of the Monkey, his zodiac stamp was issued.

zh: 红底金猴，小小一枚，后来成了无数人珍藏的猴票。
en: A little golden monkey on red, it became the “Monkey Stamp” cherished by countless people.

zh: 八十五岁，他开始在《收获》杂志连载小说《无愁河的浪荡汉子》。
en: At eighty-five, he began serializing a novel in the magazine Harvest — The Carefree River's Wanderer.

zh: 这些家乡的故事，他酿了六十多年，写到得意处，还哈哈大笑。
en: He had brewed these stories of home for over sixty years, and laughed out loud when a passage pleased him.

zh: 二〇二三年六月十三日，黄永玉离世，享年九十九岁。他不愿办任何告别仪式。
en: On June 13, 2023, Huang Yongyu passed away at ninety-nine. He wanted no farewell ceremony.

zh: 可他的猴子，他的猫头鹰，还在对我们眨眼睛。
en: But his monkey and his owl are still winking at us.

zh: 那个背着小包袱的少年，从来没有长大。
en: The boy with the little bundle never grew up.
